1aba7093d3.q: What financial documents does a restaurant owner need to prepare before selling through WeSellRestaurants.com?
1aba7093d3.a: Make sure your CPA is your best friend and your numbers are tied down. You need profit and loss statements, clean of any owner expenses, representing what a new owner can get from the business, referred to as owner benefits or seller's discretionary earnings. P&Ls should be done at least quarterly, if not monthly.

f0fa7f3bdd.q: What are the most common mistakes restaurant sellers make that cost them money in the sale process?
f0fa7f3bdd.a: One of the biggest mistakes is paying employees off the books, which misrepresents labor costs. Buyers are sophisticated and use AI to verify realistic margins. If you're doing this, you need a two to three year window before selling to bring those expenses onto the books. Another mistake is deferred maintenance like a piece of tape on a cooler or failing to maintain HVAC systems.
